text:
Alex: noticed a P99 latency spike + infrequent OOMs during KV cache warmup on canary yesterday. stack traces point to delayed free of logits scratchpad while activations keep growing. attaching quick dump from the run.
Marta: ugh, saw that briefly on staging too. do we know which path is holding logits/prefix buffers?
Chao: looks like the staging allocator keeps a "late_free" flag for buffers returned in batch path. when batch size jumps, the allocator defers compaction for 30s, which prevents eager reuse.
InfraBot: [alert] canary-4 OOM at 2026-03-10T18:12:43Z - GPU memory exhausted (cudaMalloc failed)
Alex: repro steps: 1) run microbench that simulates KV-heavy chat traffic with cold prefix, 2) ramp concurrent sessions from 20 -> 80 in 10s, 3) observe p99 and mem. attached perf trace: ``
# alloc timeline (shortened)
0.0s   alloc activations (A)
0.02s  alloc logits scratch (L) - deferred free
0.04s  alloc KV growth (K)
0.08s  OOM on second wave
```
Chao: profiling flamegraph shows logits slab pinned for ~18s and multiple activation slabs allocated on top. peak mem = 29.8GB, steady target for that model is ~22GB.
Ryan: kernel selector changes shouldn't affect freeing semantics, but batching heuristic does - when batcher tries to maximize throughput it holds extra workspace for next wave. could be interacting.
Sam: quick mitigation idea: early-split the logits slab on return and push smaller free-chunks into freelist for immediate reuse instead of waiting compaction. would need small impl change + a flag to toggle at runtime.
Marta: do we have telemetry to detect "deferred-free pressure"? e.g., count of buffers in deferred list vs freelist, p99 time in deferred queue.
Chao: yes, added simple hist in PR branch: `allocator.deferred_hold_ms` and `allocator.deferred_count`. during the failing run deferred_count peaked at 12 and hold_ms median = 12000.
Alex: sounds promising. Sam can you prototype the eager-split patch and add a runtime flag `REDWOOD_EAGER_SPLIT=1`? we can canary it behind a rollout.
Sam: on it. local patch (pseudo):
```
// on free(buffer b)
if (env(REDWOOD_EAGER_SPLIT)) {
  split_and_push_freelist(b);
} else {
  deferred_list.push(b);
}
```
Will add unit + small perf run.
Ryan: also suggest lowering the batcher lookahead from 3->1 for canary; that reduces reserved workspace for next wave and reduces simultaneous live buffers. quick config: `BATCHER_LOOKAHEAD=1`.
Marta: can we also add a registry alert: if `allocator.deferred_count > 8` and `gpu_mem_used > 0.85 * gpu_mem_total` then page an oncall?
Alex: yes add alert. Chao/Sam, action items: 1) Sam implement eager-split flag + tests, 2) Chao run perf with `REDWOOD_EAGER_SPLIT=1` + `BATCHER_LOOKAHEAD=1` on canary and capture `allocator.*` histograms, p99 and peak mem, 3) Marta add alert rule.
Chao: will run two back-to-back canaries and post numbers. rough expectation: drop peak by ~6GB if freelist reuse is immediate.
Sam: patch drafted, pushing to `pr/eager-split-272`. includes metrics tagging and fallback to deferred path.
Alex: awesome. once canary looks good roll to staging. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Marta: assigning to Chao/Sam and tagging infra team for alerting changes.
InfraBot: [deployment] pr/eager-split-272 deployed to canary-4 (image: rwd/infer:canary-eager-split)
